jobs.description_text: Job Summary: Lucid Motors is seeking a highly motivated Senior Engineer, Charging Software Testing to support the development, validation, and verification of high-voltage (HV) and vehicle charging systems. Design, build, and maintain automated test benches for both high and low-voltage systems. Data logging and data distillation using tools like Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, Canape, Canaylzer. jobs.title: Senior Process Development Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are seeking an experienced Senior Process Development Engineer to lead the specification and advancement of powertrain product, process, and equipment technologies at Lucid Motors. This role requires a strong foundation in mechanical design, feasibility testing, electromechanical equipment integration, and process validation, including DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in laser welding, equipment design, product design for manufacturability, and metrology-based quality evaluation. Success in this position requires the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a strong commitment to technical excellence and continuous improvement. The Role: Lead new product development efforts, including ideation, feasibility studies, and prototype development. Develop workholding strategies and solutions to adapt universal capital equipment for process and metrology requirements. Collaborate cross-functionally to define and refine new product performance requirements and specifications. Perform materials characterization, analysis, and selection; partner with modeling engineers to develop technical roadmaps and execution plans. Work closely with process engineers to define product-specific process and equipment requirements, supporting a smooth handoff to Operations, including training and implementation. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Homologation Engineer
jobs.description_text: At Lucid, safety is foundational to the development and deployment of automated driving technologies. Our Primary Safety Homologation team is responsible for ensuring that autonomous driving systems are supported by robust safety arguments, evidence-based decision making, and effective engagement with regulators and technical assessment bodies worldwide. We are seeking a Technical Specialist or Senior Homologation Engineer, ADS Safety Assurance and Regulatory Strategy to play a key role in evaluating, challenging, and strengthening the safety case for Level 3 and Level 4 Automated Driving Systems (ADS). This position requires a highly motivated individual with expertise in safety engineering, regulatory compliance, functional safety, and autonomous vehicle technologies. The successful candidate will work across engineering, safety, validation, legal, policy, and product development teams to help ensure that Lucid's ADS products are supported by defensible, audit-ready safety arguments suitable for regulatory assessment, deployment approvals, and commercialization. This role provides a unique opportunity to influence the future of autonomous vehicle safety while engaging with a broad range of engineering disciplines and external stakeholders. jobs.description_text: Lucid is seeking a Senior Supplier Quality Engineer to support the Plant Supplier Quality team in Arizona. This individual-contributor role owns supplier quality performance for assigned mass-production suppliers from initial escalation through permanent corrective action. You will lead technical problem-solving, protect manufacturing operations from supplier-related disruptions, and build productive relationships that improve quality over time. You will also support new-product build events and help transition new components and suppliers into stable mass production. Success will be measured by effective issue containment, durable root-cause elimination, improved supplier performance, and clear visibility into quality risks, priorities, and results. This is an opportunity to influence supplier quality at the plant level while working directly across Lucid’s manufacturing ecosystem. Issue Resolution: Lead rapid containment, root-cause analysis, and permanent countermeasures for supplier-related quality issues to protect plant operations and prevent recurrence. jobs.title: Service Advisor
jobs.description_text: As a Service Advisor at Lucid, you will be responsible for providing excellent customer service to our clients and ensuring an exceptional customer experience at all steps of the service process. You will greet clients promptly, consult with technicians, accurately document client concerns for diagnosis and repair, and explain all service options to clients, including time and cost estimates. You will also track all client vehicles through the maintenance and repair process, ensuring that work done meets Lucid's quality standards before vehicles are returned to clients. This position will put you at the forefront of Sila’s hardware and process development efforts, with a focus on leading, designing, executing, and analyzing experiments on lab and pilot scale equipment as part of a growing, dynamic test engineering team. Your experiments will deliver the critical data necessary to understand how equipment design, process conditions, and material structure interact, enabling data-informed decisions for scale-up. You will strive to accelerate Sila’s pace of learning and drive the company towards impactful decisions. You work as a team: you will rely on engineers, scientists, and technicians who, in turn, rely on you. You work at the interface of material science, process engineering, equipment engineering, systems engineering, and data science. You turn raw data into critical insights. You run towards problems not away. If someone has an issue they need to debug, they come to you. You use your fundamental understanding, experiential insight, creative thinking, and the rest of the team to solve tough problems quickly and thoroughly. You have excellent communication skills and deftly navigate through technical discussions and debates. Develop and operationalize electrochemical tests at the half and full cell level to extract material-level kinetics and physics for Li-ion active materials. jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Unit 26
jobs.description_text: Build the 26th We promise the world 25 new products a year. Unit 26 builds the 26th: SharkNinja itself. Inside a company moving as fast as ours, the highest-impact work doesn’t always fit neatly into anyone’s job description. It sits between functions and stays unsolved until someone owns it completely, builds the solution, proves its value, and ships it. That’s where Unit 26 comes in. Unit 26 is a small team of builders reporting to the Chief of Staff to the CEO, with executive sponsorship and access to the C-suite from day one. Our job is to solve problems that don’t have an obvious owner or an existing solution. When your build ships, you hand it to the business unit waiting on the other side and move to the next one. Zero to one, again and again. We’re starting with just eight builders, from inside SharkNinja and out. The Role You’ll work directly with teams across SharkNinja to understand what needs to change and what a successful solution must deliver. Then you own the build. What you make will flex with the problem: an app, an algorithm, an AI agent that eliminates thousands of hours of manual work, or a system that doesn’t yet exist at SharkNinja, or anywhere else. Some of your work will change how we run the company. Some will end up inside our products. Some will be things we haven’t imagined yet. Here, the building comes first. You’ll build on top of a global innovation engine that reaches tens of millions of homes, and you’ll have a stake in the value you create.
